name.en: Universidad de Santa Isabel Main Building

sources.title: OpenStreetMap footprint relation/2418000
sources.note: ODbL. The mapped courtyard building in the south of the USI campus, retained unchanged; the site detail's roof wings over it light with it. Edit dates are not construction dates. Generated subdivision: San Francisco. The campus grounds stay the separate Universidad de Santa Isabel landmark.

sources.title: Naga City Ordinance No. 2003-003, Section 6
sources.note: Enacted January 15, 2003. Lists the original main building of Universidad de Santa Isabel and its stone walls for preservation.

sources.title: Philippine Registry of Cultural Property (NCCA): Naga City entries
sources.note: Inspected October 8, 2026. Universidad de Santa Isabel: NHCP National Historical Landmark and historical marker, and local cultural property under Ordinance No. 2003-003.

sources.title: Owner identification: USI original main building
sources.note: October 9, 2026. The owner identified the courtyard building (relation/2418000) as the original main building; the public sources reviewed name a main building but do not locate it on the campus.

sources.title: PTV News: Century-old university listed as national historical landmark
sources.note: Reports that the NHCP granted national historical landmark recognition at a January 30 marker unveiling, under NHCP Resolution No. 3 of February 26, 2018, and that the university was established in 1868.

text.en: The original main building of Universidad de Santa Isabel and its stone walls were listed for preservation by City Ordinance No. 2003-003.
The university, established in 1868, was declared a national historical landmark under NHCP Resolution No. 3 of February 26, 2018.
The NHCP formally granted the recognition at the unveiling of its marker on the campus.
